system.description:
Keepers of the old way, hunters are survival experts that specialize in exploiting their enemies’ weaknesses.


Iconic Hunters

• Aloy, Horizon

• Aragorn, The Lord of the Rings

• Samus Aran, Metroid

• San, Princess Mononoke


Playing Hunter

The hunter is a low defense, high-crit striker. They can be built for Melee or Ranged positions.


Action: Attack

Move: Midline or Backline


Training: Melee, Ranged, Survival

features.name: Hunter's Mark
features.description:
You can choose a Target when you attack it or by skipping your Move, declaring it is your Mark until you declare a new Mark. The following rules apply while you have a Mark:


• Your attacks against it with Weapons that have the Keen or Vicious property also have the other property, and Crit if a Bonus causes the result to exceed your Crit range.


• You roll two d20s on Checks to track it, and use the higher result.

features.name: Survivalist
features.description:
You gain a Perk with Survival Training as a Prerequisite, ignoring other prerequisites for it.


Further, you have Favor on Checks to track, navigate, and against extreme temperatures, and you can Forage at a Normal Travel Pace.

features.name: Rover
features.description:
Difficult Terrain doesn’t impede your walking Speed, and you have Climb and Swim.


Further, you have a 5' bonus to Speed, which increases by 5' every 4 levels hereafter.

features.name: Lethal Precision
features.description: When damage is dealt to your Mark by you or an Ally on your Turn, the Mark takes 1 extra damage. This extra damage increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Killer Instinct
features.description: You can sense Beings within Far as if by Blindsight if they are missing any HP or are your Mark.

features.name: Apex Predator
features.description: Your Mark is Weak to your attacks.
